Task S007 / v0.9.36

Christian Verrecchia · 27 November2026 · bounded internally verified development preview; physical/commercial and final clean-Windows release qualification remain pending.

1. Objective, physical equations, units, sources, boundaries, gauge, approximation, workflow and limitations

# Bounded native higher-order magnetostatics — S007 / v0.9.36

In Analysis, spatial Netgen/NGSolve jobs now offer **Native HCurl order0,2or3**. Order0 is the original default. Orders2/3 require exactly1mesh pass; higher-order recovery-driven adaptation is not qualified. Use the same original core/material/gap/container/independent-winding/layer workflow. Native orders affect only the optional compiled linear3D backend. The browser WebAssembly reference solver cannot run native FEM. Planar native H1 stays unchanged and accepts only the default spatial-order setting0.

CLI: `python tools/native_solve.py --project project.json --maxh-mm 200 --passes 1 --hcurl-order 3 --json result.json --output fields.html`. Values above are for the delivered1m verification box, not a universal transformer mesh recommendation. Protected HTTP native jobs accept `options.hcurl_order` and existing `options.probes_m` for up to64physical metre-coordinate probes. Wrong dimensions, boolean/fractional/unsupported orders and higher-order requests with multiple passes are rejected in pure server preflight before replacing an accepted job/field. Direct native worker/CLI execution shares those checks. Existing actual cell,45000total-space-DOF and240sworker guards remain. A requested higher order may exceed those budgets; rejection does not prove convergence.

The space is exactly `ng.HCurl(mesh,order=selected,dirichlet='outer',nograds=True)` with pinned NGSolve/Netgen6.2.2608. Tested parameter0and1 give identical1001total DOFs and identical probes on the627tet prototype, so1is not offered as a misleading refinement level. Orders2and3 add genuine curl approximation capacity. These are literal NGSolve parameter values; do not assume another FEM library uses the same numbering. No new runtime dependency or reference-kernel change is introduced.

Original linear equations remain B=curl A, curl(nu curl A)+epsilon*nu/L²*A=J, with tangential A=0on the closed outer box. A[Wb/m],B[T],J[A/m²],mu[H/m],nu=1/mu[m/H],L[m],epsilon dimensionless. The explicit numerical regularization is retained from the original backend, not new physical energy. Wphysical=integral(nu B·B)/2[J]; Wgauge=integral(epsilon nu A·A/L²)/2[J] is separately recorded as a fraction of physical energy. Source work, actual free-equation residual, reciprocity and existing physical-energy checks remain active. Tz=NI/window-height[A/m] inside each fitted source support gives J=curl T as an ideal closed sheet current; weak loading is integral(Tz curl(v)_z). Materials remain linear isotropic; declared/assigned AC solids and B-H sources are rejected as before. No finite winding copper, terminals/returns, eddy loss, nonlinear3D, loaded resonant network or circuit transient is added.

Higher-order native B varies inside cells. **Original plots, viewer streamlines, peak/region summaries and ordinary field exports retain element-centroid samples**, not the complete high-order basis. JSON fields.representation states this and the peak GUI metric is labelled PEAK CENTROID-SAMPLED B. Warnings and the Analysis control explain the limitation. Direct native API probes evaluate the actual high-order field; energy and matrices use the native FE forms. Re-solving the saved exact project/settings is needed for further point evaluations; the original exported arrays are not a serialized continuous high-order solution. The recovery indicator still uses the original lowest-order recovery space and remains uncalibrated; its value is not a high-order error estimate. Higher-order jobs stop after the declared single pass, not a convergence claim.

Actual new evidence is sample_results/native_order_s007/. Nine production isolated-worker cases use the same unit air-sheet source/probes as S005/S006: closed rectangular source x,y,z0.4–0.6m, N=1,I=1A, no core or finite copper. Reference probe vectors are the explicitly retained independently calculated S006 free-space Biot–Savart values, not new analytical/Maxwell/hardware computations. Two1m-box meshes maxh0.2/0.14m have627/1998tetrahedra; an enlarged2m-box maxh0.3m has2331. The source and probes are rigidly translated, not scaled. Each0/2/3order triplet has identical actual coordinate/connectivity/material SHA256. Air changes also alter exterior mesh topology and target size, so they are not an isolated boundary-error study.

At627tets, order0→3 increases freeDOFs497→7808 and reduces the worst of three vector-probe discrepancies48.686%→3.524%. At1998tets, order3's worst probe discrepancy is2.354%; at2331tets in the enlarged box it is2.237%. One coarse order3probe happens to agree better than its finer result, so point agreement is nonmonotonic. No Richardson/error bound, globally converged energy/matrix, design qualification or commercial parity is inferred. Full source/mesh results, actual probes, full unit matrices, gauge fractions and physical checks are retained. The illustrative model does not represent full CLLC operation.

Focused pure/reference checks test transactional invalid-order rejection; genuine native tests solve both original and order3fields/matrices, source preservation and energy/reciprocity checks. Existing native regression runs retain explicit optional skips. Genuine DOM/canvas + protected HTTP drives the new order3control, saves settings and solves nonzero spatial fields; layout is synthetic and is not Windows/browser/file-dialog qualification. Exact frozen-Windows CI additionally solves a real order3native job, saves its result and rejects an invalid two-pass request while retaining the accepted job/field. Existing browser/reference and original workflow checks remain. The final complete source-bound numerical profile is separately audited; the earlier profile started before display/export-label clarification is retained as source-different/unqualified and never credited to the final source.

Two real default-order2D/3D results are byte-identical against the preceding checkout after excluding only stats.seconds and the newly added descriptive stats.native_hcurl_order field. Every other deterministic field, full mesh, matrix, source and diagnostic participates. Reproduce with `python verification/check_native_defaults_s007.py /path/to/extracted/S006/magnetics_studio`. Actual source CLI and DOM/native worker execution are also checked. These are internally verified fixtures, not proof for every material/geometry.

Native qualification used a separate Linux development environment: ngsolve/netgen-mesher6.2.2608, NumPy2.3.5 and SciPy1.17.0, with actual installed transitive versions recorded. Initial --target installation succeeded but failed import with KeyError: tkernel before any FEM execution; a normal isolated virtual-environment installation corrected library discovery. No package/version or numerical guard was weakened. Native libraries and development environments are not duplicated into this source archive. QA/report generators, test Node/DOM/Wasm/browser dependencies, result logs and source snapshots are development-only. The source ZIP uses ZIP_LZMA: extract with `python -m zipfile -e magnetics_studio_v0_9_36.zip extracted`; Explorer extraction remains unqualified. The Windows executable preview is a separate ordinary ZIP with its complete folder. Existing dependency/data-rights redistribution and final permitted clean-Windows10/11 offline/no-Python-installed qualification remain pending.

Next: qualify broader native source/geometry/p/mesh/domain/observable combinations and higher-order recovery/display/export before extending adaptation; continue joined finite winding/return/core, matched adviser/FEM conversion, native nonlinear/AC and full CLLC. Preserve all old report/evidence files. No Maxwell/FEMM/COMSOL/Flux/hardware validation, complete stationary parity or final released Windows qualification is claimed.

Windows packaging correction: the first source-specific frozen CI run46055149854 failed before any native FEM at netgen.load_occ_libs, KeyError:tkernel, and correctly published no executable release. The new native smoke check exposed a previously untested bundled FEM import. The builder now stages original netgen-occt metadata with a bundle-relative RECORD and explicitly collects its exact installed DLLs in netgen_occt_libs. All upstream DLL bytes, version and licence metadata remain unchanged; RECORD is explicitly relocated and is not claimed byte-identical. Two synthetic packaging tests exercise standard importlib.metadata enumeration, real bundle-local resolution and exact source bytes plus absent-kernel rejection, without claiming Windows execution. The actual frozen solve/rejection/field-retention check remains the acceptance gate; no native import or numerical guard is bypassed.

The Pages source-build/browser test steps passed initially, but its first deployment attempt reported zero artifact metadata immediately after upload and an independent metadata visibility check. An actual failed-job rerun passed; no artifact guard, Pages permissions or unrelated portfolio/Loss Lab source was changed for this retry. Both complete attempted logs are retained.

0012      passes=number(o.get('max_passes',1),'Native passes',1,4)  #: Keep the original finite numeric pass guard in lightweight preflight.
0013      if int(passes)!=passes:raise ValueError('Native passes must be an integer')  #: Reject fractional work requests before accepting a job.
0014      if order and passes!=1:raise ValueError('Higher HCurl orders currently require exactly one mesh pass')  #: Exclude unqualified higher-order recovery-driven adaptation explicitly.
0015      return order  #: Return the exact selected native polynomial-order parameter.

0018  def solve_native(project, options=None, matrix=True, progress=None):  #: Solve a validated ordinary project using the optional external backend.
0019      import ngsolve as ng  #: Load native FEM only inside the isolated worker process.
0020      from netgen.occ import Box, Pnt, WorkPlane, Glue, OCCGeometry  #: Reuse OpenCASCADE geometry and Netgen meshing.

0037      passes = number(o.get('max_passes', 1), 'Native passes', 1, 4)  #: Bound the complete solve/estimate/refine sequence.

0041      def start(self, request):
0042          action = request.get('action','solve')  #: Identify separate component synthesis before requiring an unrelated FEM project.
0043          project = None if action=='design_transformer' else validate(request['project'])  #: Preserve all existing project validation while keeping requirements-driven design independent.
0044          if action not in ['solve','mesh','convergence','sweep','adaptive','ac','ac_sweep','ngsolve','openmagnetics','geometry_cad','design_transformer','port_study']:  #: Accept explicit isolated transformer design while preserving existing field and CAD actions.
0045              raise ValueError('Unknown analysis action')
0046          if action=='ngsolve':  #: Reject unsupported native-order combinations before replacing an accepted job or field.
0047              from engine.ngsolve_backend import check_native_order  #: Keep all compiled imports isolated from lightweight server validation.
0048              check_native_order(project,request.get('options'))  #: Preserve accepted state for wrong dimensions, noninteger/duplicate orders and unsupported higher-order adaptation.
0049          if action=='port_study':  #: Preflight all physical mesh/air cases without replacing the accepted workspace state.
0050              from engine.port_study import plan_study  #: Keep compiled native libraries outside reference-study validation.
0051              plan_study(project,request.get('options'))  #: Reject nonlinear/AC, unsupported geometry, invalid ports and excessive actual fitted work transactionally.
0052          if action=='design_transformer':  #: Validate catalogue design transactionally before replacing any accepted job or result.
0053              from engine.transformer_designer import validate_request as validate_design  #: Keep compiled libraries out of HTTP preflight.
0054              validate_design(request.get('design_request'))  #: Reject invalid targets, waveforms and constraints without changing the accepted workspace state.
0055              if not backend_status()['design_transformer']:raise ValueError('Transformer designer requires optional PyOpenMagnetics==1.7.35')  #: Make a missing native dependency an actionable preflight failure.
0056          if action in ['solve', 'adaptive', 'convergence', 'sweep', 'ngsolve']:  #: Mesh-only and dedicated AC/core-screening actions retain their distinct purposes.
0057              require_static_sources(project)  #: Return an actionable client error without replacing the previous job or field result.
0058          if action == 'geometry_cad':  #: Reject unsupported geometry before replacing an accepted job or result.
0059              from engine.geometry_cad import geometry_plan  #: Use lightweight preflight without loading a native CAD kernel into the server.
0060              if type(request.get('include_turn_solids',False)) is not bool: raise ValueError('include_turn_solids must be boolean')  #: Refuse ambiguous options before replacing a previous accepted job.
0061              if type(request.get('include_bobbin_sleeves',False)) is not bool or request.get('include_bobbin_sleeves',False) and not request.get('include_turn_solids',False): raise ValueError('Boolean include_bobbin_sleeves requires closed turns')  #: Keep inferred sleeve completion explicit and transaction-safe before native work.
0062              if request.get('include_turn_solids',False):  #: Bind optional turn geometry to the actual complete builder recipe before starting native work.
0063                  from engine.turn_cad import turn_plan  #: Run lightweight packing/source-consistency checks without importing CAD.
0064                  turn_plan(project)  #: Reject stale raw field edits, unsupported dimensions and overfilled blocks transactionally.
0065              if 'bobbin_parts' in request:  #: Validate all declared explicit geometry before replacing an accepted job or field.
0066                  if not request.get('include_turn_solids',False) or request.get('include_bobbin_sleeves',False):raise ValueError('Explicit bobbin parts require closed turns and exclude inferred sleeves')  #: Reject conflicting geometry modes transactionally.
0067                  from engine.bobbin_cad import bobbin_plan  #: Keep native CAD out of the preflight server.
0068                  bobbin_plan(project,request['bobbin_parts'])  #: Require exact source/anchor association and explicit typed SI dimensions.
0069              if 'turn_ports' in request:  #: Validate explicit cut dimensions/source binding before replacing accepted jobs or fields.
0070                  if not request.get('include_turn_solids',False):raise ValueError('Turn ports require individual turns')  #: Do not silently ignore selected cuts in ordinary box/prism export.
0071                  from engine.turn_ports import port_plan  #: Keep native CAD imports out of transactional HTTP preflight.
0072                  port_plan(project,request['turn_ports'])  #: Reject stale, null, duplicate or geometrically invalid terminal packets.
0073              if 'turn_links' in request:  #: Validate exact connection incidence/path data before replacing an accepted job or field.
0074                  if not request.get('include_turn_solids',False) or not isinstance(request.get('turn_ports'),dict) or request.get('include_bobbin_sleeves',False) or 'bobbin_parts' in request:raise ValueError('Links require individual turns and slit packet; bobbin/sleeves are outside this pilot')  #: Keep explicitly unsupported combinations and ignored packets transaction-safe.
0075                  from engine.turn_links import link_plan  #: Run pure source/graph/path validation without loading native CAD into the server.
0076                  link_plan(project,request['turn_ports'],request['turn_links'])  #: Reject stale cuts,wrong electrical owners,branches,cycles and invalid SI routes before starting a new job.
0077              geometry_plan(project, request.get('include_envelopes', True))  #: Keep polygon, complexity and thickness failures actionable and transaction-safe.
0078          with self.lock:
0079              if self.job and self.job['status']=='running':
0080                  raise ValueError('An analysis is already running')
0081              job_id = secrets.token_hex(8)
0082              self.cancel.clear()
0083              self.job = {'id':job_id,'status':'running','action':action,'log':[], 'started':time.time()}
0084          def log(message):
0085              with self.lock:
0086                  self.job['log'].append(str(message))
0087                  self.job['log'] = self.job['log'][-250:]
0088          def worker():
0089              try:
0090                  if action in ['ngsolve', 'openmagnetics', 'geometry_cad', 'design_transformer']:  #: Route transformer design, native FEM and CAD through the existing cancellable isolated process boundary.
0091                      result = run_backend(action, request, log, self.cancel.is_set)  #: Preserve real worker errors and avoid loading two CAD kernels into the GUI server.
0092                  elif action=='mesh':  #: Preserve the original mesh-only branch after the new isolated backend dispatch.
0093                      result = {'project':project,'mesh':mesh_public(build_mesh(project,log,self.cancel.is_set)),'kind':'mesh'}
0094                  elif action=='port_study':  #: Run the explicitly selected reference multiport study as an ordinary cancellable job.
0095                      from engine.port_study import port_study  #: Reuse the shared actual matrix/mesh/domain implementation.
0096                      result=port_study(project,request.get('options'),log,self.cancel.is_set)  #: Retain prior accepted fields when this separate study completes or is cancelled.
0097                  elif action=='convergence':
0098                      result = convergence(project,log,self.cancel.is_set)
0099                  elif action=='sweep':
0100                      result = current_sweep(project,request.get('winding_id'),request.get('values'),log,self.cancel.is_set)
0101                  elif action=='ac':  #: Route a single accepted AC job to the dedicated frequency-domain branch.
0102                      result = solve_ac(project,request.get('options'),log,self.cancel.is_set)  #: Pass the model, run settings, progress callback and cancellation flag into the real complex-field solver.
0103                  elif action=='ac_sweep':  #: Route a bounded AC frequency study separately from static current and mesh studies.
0104                      result = frequency_sweep(project,request.get('frequencies'),request.get('options'),log,self.cancel.is_set)  #: Pass the complete frequency list and common controls to independently recomputed AC solves.
0105                  elif action=='adaptive':
0106                      result = adaptive_solve(project,request.get('options'),bool(request.get('matrix',True)),log,self.cancel.is_set)
0107                  else:
0108                      result = solve_project(project,bool(request.get('matrix',True)),log,self.cancel.is_set)
0109                  if self.cancel.is_set():
0110                      raise Cancelled('Analysis cancelled')
0111                  with self.lock:
0112                      self.result = result
0113                      if 'fields' in result:
0114                          self.field_result = result
0115                      self.result_job = job_id
0116                      self.job['status'] = 'done'
0117                      log('Completed')
0118              except Cancelled as e:
0119                  with self.lock:
0120                      self.job['status'] = 'cancelled'
0121                      self.job['error'] = str(e)
0122              except Exception as e:
0123                  traceback.print_exc()
0124                  with self.lock:
0125                      self.job['status'] = 'error'
0126                      self.job['error'] = str(e)
0127          threading.Thread(target=worker,daemon=True).start()
0128          return job_id

0290  def main():
0291      ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Magnetics Studio 0.9.36 — MAS local native fit and limited magnetic FEM')  #: Identify the component-adviser release without claiming new FEM physics coverage.
0292      ap.add_argument('--project',help='JSON project for a command-line solve')
0293      ap.add_argument('--output',default='results.html',help='CLI self-contained HTML report')
0294      ap.add_argument('--json',dest='json_output',help='Full result JSON file')
0295      ap.add_argument('--vtk',dest='vtk_output',help='VTK field export file')
0296      ap.add_argument('--csv',dest='csv_output',help='CSV field export file')
0297      ap.add_argument('--port',type=int,default=0,help='Local GUI port (0 selects an available port)')
0298      ap.add_argument('--no-open',action='store_true')
0299      ap.add_argument('--pure-python',action='store_true',help='Disable acceleration even if SciPy is installed')
0300      ap.add_argument('--no-matrix',action='store_true',help='Skip unit solves for inductance extraction')
0301      ap.add_argument('--adaptive', action='store_true', help='Adaptive linear 2D solve, retaining ordinary solve as the default')
0302      ap.add_argument('--adaptive-passes', type=int, default=4, help='Maximum adaptive passes, 1–8')
0303      ap.add_argument('--ac', action='store_true', help='Linear 2D RMS phasor AC/eddy-current solve')  #: Add an explicit CLI switch for the limited linear planar AC analysis.
0304      ap.add_argument('--frequency-hz', type=float, help='AC solve frequency in Hz; otherwise use saved settings')  #: Allow a CLI frequency override; absent overrides retain the saved AC settings.
0305      args = ap.parse_args()
0306      if args.ac and args.adaptive:  #: Prevent unsupported mixing of the static adaptive loop with an AC analysis.
0307          ap.error('--ac and --adaptive are separate analyses; AC adaptation is not implemented')  #: Explain that AC-specific adaptation is not implemented instead of ignoring a requested analysis mode.
0308      if args.pure_python:
0309          os.environ['MAGNETICS_PURE_PYTHON']='1'
0310      if args.project:
0311          p = json.loads(pathlib.Path(args.project).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
0312          r = None if args.ac else (adaptive_solve(p, {'max_passes': args.adaptive_passes}, not args.no_matrix, print) if args.adaptive else solve_project(p,not args.no_matrix,print))  #: Skip any unnecessary static solve for an AC request; retain the existing static/adaptive paths otherwise.
0313          if args.ac:  #: Enter the explicit AC CLI branch only when requested.
0314              controls = {'frequency_Hz': args.frequency_hz} if args.frequency_hz is not None else None  #: Construct a named frequency override only when the user supplied it.
0315              r = solve_ac(p,controls,print)  #: Run the actual AC equations and forward progress to the terminal before ordinary result export.
0316          write_report(r,args.output)
0317          for file,value in [(args.json_output,json.dumps(r,allow_nan=False)),(args.vtk_output,vtk(r)),(args.csv_output,field_csv(r))]:
0318              if file:
0319                  pathlib.Path(file).write_text(value,encoding='utf-8')
0320          print(json.dumps(r['stats'],indent=2))
0321          print('Report:',pathlib.Path(args.output).resolve())
0322          if not args.no_open:
0323              webbrowser.open(pathlib.Path(args.output).resolve().as_uri())
0324          return
0325      server = make_server(args.port)
0326      url = f'http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}/'
0327      print('Magnetics Studio 0.9.36\nOpen:',url,'\nLocal machine only. Press Ctrl+C to stop.',flush=True)  #: Report the actual source version without changing local launch/shutdown behaviour.
0328      if not args.no_open:
0329          webbrowser.open(url)
0330      try:
0331          server.serve_forever()
0332      except KeyboardInterrupt:
0333          server.studio_state.cancel.set()
0334      finally:
0335          server.server_close()

0339      main()

0013  <dialog id="guideDialog"><div class="dialog-head"><h2>Engineering workflow</h2><button data-close="guideDialog">×</button></div><div class="guide"><p class="eyebrow">MAGNETICS STUDIO 0.8 · INDEPENDENT IMPLEMENTATION</p><h3>Guided builder</h3><p>Click Builder and follow Core type → Dimensions → Material → Air gaps → Circuits → Windings → Interleaving → Nameplate/build. The same circuit and winding inputs drive 2D and 3D geometry.</p><h3>Circuits and independent windings</h3><p>A named circuit, such as Phase U, contains its own winding count and winding definitions. Primary and secondary have independent turns, current and phase. Only physical layers of one electrical winding carry the same series current. Reorder those layers per limb to define interleaving. Single, multilayer and interleaved arrangements are supported. Declared totals and odd final layers are checked.</p><p>Signed instantaneous current is the default excitation. Optional sinusoidal snapshot mode uses peak current × cos(snapshot angle + winding phase). It is a prescribed magnetostatic point, not a voltage-driven or AC circuit solve. Phase names do not impose phase angles.</p><h3>Material and image digitiser</h3><p>Select a material, enter linear μr, import numeric B–H data, or click Digitise from graph image in Material. Load a screenshot, enter graph limits/units/scales and calibrate A=(Xmin,Ymin), B=(Xmax,Ymin), C=(Xmin,Ymax). Trace one monotonic positive branch. Scroll zooms; Shift/right-drag pans. Move/delete points or edit their SI values. Invalid points block application; including (0,0) is an explicit assumption. Images stay in the local browser. Perspective photographs are not corrected.</p><p>Nonlinear reversible B–H is available in 2D. 3D remains linear; storing a curve in 3D does not activate nonlinear physics. Temperature/frequency labels select curve data explicitly; no automatic scaling or loss model is implied.</p><h3>2D and 3D windings</h3><p>2D supports full winding-block rectangles or separately meshed round/litz/foil/rectangular turn sections. A region carrying n turns has Jz = ±nI/A. Each winding has both + and − sections, preserving total ampere-turns. Round curves are faceted polygons. Litz is homogenized within each bundle, not resolved strand by strand. Stack depth scales linkage and energy; planar end effects are absent.</p><p>3D uses closed ideal rectangular current sheets at the packing-defined mean radius and axial extent. It computes 3D field end effects in a finite air domain. Winding display envelopes do not represent finite-copper eddy-current physics. Curved toroidal 3D cores and individual 3D wires are not implemented.</p><h3>Mesh, solve and inspect</h3><p>Preview and check fit, then use the model in the workspace, generate mesh and solve. Standard 3D budget is 44k tetrahedra; the explicitly selected extended budget allows 120k and may be slower. The builder shows a mesh estimate. Uncheck Matrix for field-only analysis. Failed convergence is rejected.</p><p>Use 3D field volume for magnitude colours, volume arrows, traced B paths, transparency and capped core surfaces. Rotating field slice remains a single plane. Streamlines are approximate postprocessing of elementwise fields. The solid model view provides part selection, hiding, cutaway and display OBJ export.</p><h3>Results and verification</h3><p>Linear inductance uses independent unit excitations. Native 3D section matrices are grouped by electrical winding, not by circuit container. Per-container winding-pair leakage assumes the selected other winding is shorted and all remaining winding currents are zero/open; the full coupled matrix is retained. Nonlinear points do not have a constant linear inductance matrix.</p><p>Check finer mesh and larger air boundaries. A tiny algebraic residual or energy discrepancy alone is not evidence of engineering accuracy. The closed outer boundary imposes zero normal flux and is not an infinite open boundary. Sharp-corner field peaks can remain mesh dependent.</p><h3>Save and reuse</h3><p>Save project JSON for the workspace, builder input JSON for the recipe, or a digitiser session including the source graph image. Changing raw generated geometry flags the recipe as stale; rebuilding does not infer manual edits. Previous v0.5 recipes migrate with their explicit geometry preserved. CSV, JSON, VTK, PNG and self-contained HTML reports remain available.</p><h3>Release boundaries</h3><p>Independent research software with limited validation. Linear 2D AC/eddy-current analysis is available with explicit solid-conductor current constraints and RMS phasors. No 3D/nonlinear AC, transient, core-loss, hysteresis, thermal, permanent-magnet, force/torque, arbitrary CAD or general 3D adaptive-meshing solver is added. Linear 2D local residual-driven refinement is available from Analysis; its indicator is not a certified error bound. The circuit hierarchy is a modelling definition, not a general electrical network solver.</p></div></dialog>
0014  <dialog id="exportDialog"><div class="dialog-head"><h2>Export analysis</h2><button data-close="exportDialog">×</button></div><div class="export-grid"><button data-export="html">HTML report<small>Offline field plot & summary</small></button><button data-export="json">Full results JSON<small>Mesh, fields, project & checks</small></button><button data-export="csv">Element field CSV<small>Coordinates, B, H & volumes</small></button><button data-export="vtk">VTK mesh & fields<small>For compatible post-processors</small></button><button id="exportImage">Viewport PNG<small>Current field view</small></button><button id="exportStudy">Study JSON<small>Convergence / current sweep</small></button></div></dialog>
0015  <div id="toast" role="status" hidden></div>
0016  <dialog id="builderDialog" class="builder-dialog"><div id="builderRoot"></div></dialog></body></html>

0001  """Source-form command-line solve and field report using the isolated native backend."""
0002  import argparse  #: Parse explicit model and mesh controls.
0003  import json  #: Read the original shared project format.
0004  import pathlib  #: Resolve source imports and selected output files.
0005  import sys  #: Use this checkout's engine from tools/.
0006  sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))  #: Preserve source-tree identity for imports.
0007  from engine.backend_process import run_backend  #: Reuse the same isolation/cancellation protocol as the GUI.
0008  from engine.export import write_report  #: Reuse the actual offline 2D/3D field viewer and exports.
0009  
0010  
0011  def main():  #: Keep CLI execution separate from imports and testing.
0012      parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Netgen/NGSolve linear 2D/3D magnetostatics')  #: State current physical applicability explicitly.
0013      parser.add_argument('--project', required=True)  #: Require an actual shared-format model.
0014      parser.add_argument('--maxh-mm', type=float, default=15)  #: Expose native unstructured mesh size in familiar millimetres.
0015      parser.add_argument('--passes', type=int, default=1)  #: Bound local refinement through the validated backend controls.
0016      parser.add_argument('--output', default='native_fields.html')  #: Provide a read-only offline solved-field artifact.
0017      parser.add_argument('--json', default='native_result.json')  #: Preserve the exact mesh, fields and solve evidence.
0018      parser.add_argument('--no-matrix', action='store_true')  #: Allow a faster operating-point-only solve.
0019      parser.add_argument('--hcurl-order',type=int,choices=[0,2,3],default=0)  #: Expose explicitly qualified native spatial order parameters while preserving the original default.
0020      args = parser.parse_args()  #: Apply the declared source-form CLI contract.
0021      project = json.loads(pathlib.Path(args.project).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))  #: Preserve the normal model schema and UTF-8 BOM support.
0022      result = run_backend('ngsolve', {'project': project, 'options': {'maxh_m': args.maxh_mm/1000, 'max_passes': args.passes, 'hcurl_order': args.hcurl_order}, 'matrix': not args.no_matrix}, print)  #: Run the same native physical path exposed by the GUI.
0023      write_report(result, args.output)  #: Generate a real offline field viewer from solved native data.
0024      pathlib.Path(args.json).write_text(json.dumps(result, allow_nan=False), encoding='utf-8')  #: Save complete reproducible result JSON.
0025      print(json.dumps(result['stats'], indent=2))  #: Show actual numerical evidence after successful export.
0026  
0027  
0028  if __name__ == '__main__':  #: Avoid solving a model merely by importing this module.
0029      main()  #: Execute the explicit source-form user request.

0001  """Publish the exact original interface/reference Python as a static GitHub Pages tool."""
0002  import argparse  #: Require one explicit static output destination.
0003  import hashlib  #: Bind every shipped engine/input asset to exact source bytes.
0004  import json  #: Package trusted Python/data for the browser virtual filesystem.
0005  from pathlib import Path  #: Resolve source and static output independently.
0006  import shutil  #: Copy original browser assets without reimplementing their behavior.
0007  ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]  #: Anchor all publication content to this source release.
0008  
0009  
0010  def build(destination):  #: Generate a complete, source-bound browser preview without a Python server.
0011      destination=Path(destination);destination.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);files={}  #: Preserve an explicit static output and trusted virtual source packet.
0012      for folder in ['engine','examples','data']:  #: Include exact original reference kernels, physical examples and builder/material inputs.
0013          for path in sorted((ROOT/folder).rglob('*')):  #: Traverse only declared source/data roots, excluding caches/native binaries.
0014              if path.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in path.parts and path.suffix in ['.py','.json']:files[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))]=path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')  #: Retain actual UTF-8 source/data with original virtual paths.
0015      for name in ['report.html','cad-view.js','field-view.js']:files['web/'+name]=(ROOT/'web'/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8')  #: Preserve the original offline report template and embedded view scripts inside the virtual source tree.
0016      for path in (ROOT/'web').iterdir():  #: Preserve original interface scripts/styles rather than create a mock UI.
0017          if path.is_file():shutil.copyfile(path,destination/path.name)  #: Keep exact original bytes for every reused browser asset.
0018      page=(ROOT/'web/index.html').read_text().replace('src="/','src="').replace('href="/','href="').replace('<head>','<head><script src="browser-runtime.js"></script>')  #: Make assets subdirectory-safe and install the worker API transport before original startup.
0019      (destination/'index.html').write_text(page,encoding='utf-8')  #: Publish the genuine original interface with only its transport/base-path integration changed.
0020      digitiser=destination/'digitiser.js';digitiser.write_text(digitiser.read_text().replace('/digitiser-example.png','digitiser-example.png'),encoding='utf-8')  #: Make the original digitiser image URL relative to the published tool subdirectory.
0021      shutil.copyfile(ROOT/'data/digitiser-example.png',destination/'digitiser-example.png')  #: Keep the existing digitiser example available beside other static assets.
0022      (destination/'magnetics-core.json').write_text(json.dumps({'files':files},ensure_ascii=False),encoding='utf-8')  #: Ship trusted original Python and inputs without any saved field pretending to be a new solve.
0023      manifest={'release':'0.9.36','runtime':'Pyodide 0.27.7 standard-library reference','native_backends_available':False,'source_sha256':{n:hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest() for n,text in files.items()}}  #: Make exact engine/source identity and the native capability boundary inspectable.
0024      (destination/'version.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n');return manifest  #: Preserve reproducible per-release browser provenance.
0025  
0026  
0027  if __name__=='__main__':  #: Keep imports free of publication writes.
0028      parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);parser.add_argument('output',type=Path);args=parser.parse_args();print(json.dumps(build(args.output),indent=2))  #: Build the requested static preview from this exact source checkout.

0001  """Build a Windows one-folder development preview with installed native dependencies."""
0002  import csv  #: Write frozen distribution file records with paths relative to the actual bundle root.
0003  import argparse  #: Keep the exact output and build platform explicit.
0004  import importlib.metadata as metadata  #: Inventory actual distributions and preserve upstream licence files.
0005  import json  #: Record exact packaged source and dependency provenance.
0006  from pathlib import Path  #: Resolve trusted application resources and native wheel members.
0007  import shutil  #: Copy exact runtime notices and deterministic source snapshots.
0008  import subprocess  #: Invoke PyInstaller through the selected build interpreter.
0009  import sys  #: Require a real Windows host and preserve its actual Python interpreter.
0010  ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]  #: Bind the build to this exact delivered checkout.
0011  
0012  
0013  def stage_netgen_occt(distribution, staging):  #: Preserve Netgen's metadata-driven DLL lookup within the frozen bundle instead of original installation-prefix paths.
0014      members=list(distribution.files or []);dlls=[Path(distribution.locate_file(m)) for m in members if str(m).lower().endswith('.dll')]  #: Resolve exact declared installed Windows OCCT binaries without importing native libraries.
0015      if not dlls or not any(p.name.lower()=='tkernel.dll' for p in dlls) or any(not p.is_file() for p in dlls):raise ValueError('Installed netgen-occt DLL inventory is incomplete')  #: Fail the build before generating an unusable frozen native backend.
0016      source=next((Path(distribution.locate_file(m)).parent for m in members if str(m).endswith('.dist-info/METADATA')),None)  #: Locate the owning original metadata directory from declared wheel records.
0017      if source is None:raise ValueError('Missing netgen-occt distribution metadata')  #: Require original version, licence and distribution identity.
0018      target=staging/source.name;shutil.copytree(source,target,dirs_exist_ok=True)  #: Preserve original distribution metadata while relocating only its installed-file lookup record.
0019      with (target/'RECORD').open('w',newline='',encoding='utf-8') as stream:csv.writer(stream).writerows(('netgen_occt_libs/'+p.name,'',p.stat().st_size) for p in dlls)  #: Bind upstream metadata.files lookup to actual packaged DLL paths without inventing hashes of relocated bytes.
0020      return ['--add-data',str(target)+';'+target.name]+[v for p in dlls for v in ['--add-binary',str(p)+';netgen_occt_libs']]  #: Package exact OCCT binaries separately from OCP's libraries and install the matching metadata record.
0021  
0022  
0023  def main():  #: Produce a complete one-folder Windows preview rather than cross-label a Linux executable.
0024      parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);parser.add_argument('output',type=Path);args=parser.parse_args()  #: Require an explicit distribution parent directory.
0025      if sys.platform!='win32':raise ValueError('Build this Windows package on a permitted Windows host')  #: Do not produce a platform-mislabeled application executable.
0026      notices=ROOT/'build/notices';notices.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);inventory=[]  #: Stage exact dependency notices separately from executable code.
0027      command=[sys.executable,'-m','PyInstaller','--noconfirm','--clean','--onedir','--console','--noupx','--name','MagneticsStudio','--distpath',str(args.output),'--workpath',str(ROOT/'build/pyinstaller'),'--specpath',str(ROOT/'build')]  #: Build the actual browser-launching Windows application with inspectable console errors.
0028      for folder in ['web','data','examples']:command.extend(['--add-data',str(ROOT/folder)+';'+folder])  #: Include original runtime assets, physical examples and builder/material catalogue data.
0029      for package in ['engine','tools']:command.extend(['--collect-submodules',package])  #: Retain all lazily imported original application and native worker modules.
0030      for package in ['numpy','scipy','cadquery','OCP','netgen','ngsolve','OpenMagneticsVirtualBuilder']:command.extend(['--collect-all',package])  #: Preserve required compiled libraries and package data used by original optional backends.
0031      command.extend(['--hidden-import','PyOpenMagnetics'])  #: Include the pinned extension module even though it is imported only by a native worker action.
0032      for distribution in metadata.distributions():  #: Inventory and preserve notices for the actual installed transitive environment, not guessed direct dependencies.
0033          name=distribution.metadata['Name'];record=dict(name=name,version=distribution.version,license=distribution.metadata.get('License-Expression') or distribution.metadata.get('License'),source=distribution.metadata.get('Home-page'),notices=[])  #: Retain actual upstream metadata and source attribution.
0034          command.extend(stage_netgen_occt(distribution,ROOT/'build/frozen_metadata') if name.lower().replace('_','-')=='netgen-occt' else ['--copy-metadata',name])  #: Relocate Netgen OCCT lookup metadata and binaries while retaining original metadata handling for every other distribution.
0035          for member in distribution.files or []:  #: Inspect declared installed wheel members without importing native code.
0036              path=Path(distribution.locate_file(member));relative=str(member).replace('\\','/')  #: Resolve actual native/notice bytes from this Windows build environment.
0037              if path.is_file() and any(word in path.name.lower() for word in ['license','licence','copyright','notice']):  #: Preserve original legal notice contents rather than paraphrase them.
0038                  target=notices/name/relative.replace('../','parent/');target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copyfile(path,target);record['notices'].append(relative)  #: Keep each upstream notice attributable to its owning distribution.
0039              if name.lower()=='pyopenmagnetics' and path.is_file() and path.suffix.lower()=='.dll':command.extend(['--add-binary',str(path)+';'+str(Path(relative).parent)])  #: Retain runtime-loaded Kirchhoff/native DLLs alongside the actual extension layout.
0040          inventory.append(record)  #: Preserve complete observed transitive metadata with explicit missing notice lists.
0041      (notices/'DEPENDENCIES.json').write_text(json.dumps(inventory,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')  #: Make actual runtime dependencies and notice coverage inspectable in the preview.
0042      command.extend(['--add-data',str(notices)+';THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES',str(ROOT/'desktop_launcher.py')]);subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,check=True)  #: Build only after complete resources/metadata/notices are staged.
0043      target=args.output/'MagneticsStudio';shutil.copyfile(ROOT/'requirements-desktop.txt',target/'requirements-desktop.txt')  #: Retain the exact direct build pins next to the executable.
0044      (target/'DEVELOPMENT_PREVIEW.txt').write_text('Magnetics Studio 0.9.36 development preview. Open MagneticsStudio.exe; keep the console open while using the browser. Native availability follows exact pinned backend diagnostics. Full commercial/physical/Windows release qualification remains pending.\n',encoding='utf-8')  #: Label preview scope without implying completed industrial parity or signed release status.
0045      print(json.dumps(dict(executable=str(target/'MagneticsStudio.exe'),dependencies=len(inventory))))  #: Report the concrete native Windows build output.
0046  
0047  
0048  if __name__=='__main__':main()  #: Keep imports free of application executable generation.

+"""Native order selection, actual fields and accepted-state rejection."""
+import copy,json,unittest  #: Preserve exact physical fixtures and distinct regression outcomes.
+from pathlib import Path  #: Resolve this delivered checkout's original source models.
+from engine.ngsolve_backend import check_native_order,solve_native  #: Exercise shared pure preflight and genuine native assembly.
+from engine.backend_process import backend_status  #: Keep optional compiled execution explicitly detected.
+from studio import Workspace  #: Verify real accepted-state behavior before worker launch.
+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]  #: Bind all fixtures to delivered source bytes.
+
+def project():  #: Reuse the actual physical sheet model from the preceding independent verification.
+    return json.loads((ROOT/'sample_results/local_field_s005/results.json').read_text())['rows'][0]['project']  #: Preserve exact source geometry, currents, materials and closed boundary.
+
+class OrderBoundaryTests(unittest.TestCase):  #: Always qualify pure guards without requiring native imports.
+    def test_reject_transactionally(self):  #: Unsupported numerical controls must not destroy a prior accepted job or field.
+        p=project();state=Workspace();state.job={'id':'accepted','status':'done'};state.field_result={'accepted':True}  #: Establish actual prior server state before preflight.
+        for o in [{'hcurl_order':True},{'hcurl_order':1},{'hcurl_order':2.0},{'hcurl_order':4},{'hcurl_order':2,'max_passes':2}]:  #: Include ambiguous types, duplicate space, unsupported degree and unqualified adaptation.
+            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):state.start(dict(project=p,action='ngsolve',options=o))  #: Exercise the real production preflight before state mutation or native imports.
+            self.assertEqual(state.job['id'],'accepted');self.assertEqual(state.field_result,{'accepted':True})  #: Keep accepted results and job identity after every rejected request.
+        self.assertEqual(check_native_order(p,{}),0);self.assertEqual(check_native_order(p,{'hcurl_order':3}),3)  #: Preserve original default and accept explicit bounded higher order.
+        p2=json.loads((ROOT/'examples/transformer_2d.json').read_text())  #: Retain original planar sources and formulation.
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):check_native_order(p2,{'hcurl_order':2})  #: Reject changing the planar H1 space through a spatial-only control.
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(backend_status()['ngsolve'],'Pinned native FEM unavailable')  #: Record unavailable compiled execution as skipped rather than passed numerics.
+class NativeOrderTests(unittest.TestCase):  #: Compare actual production field results at explicitly selected orders.
+    def test_real_higher_order_and_matrix(self):  #: Higher order must use actual native basis functions and retain physical source/matrix checks.
+        p=project();before=copy.deepcopy(p);rows=[];truth=json.loads((ROOT/'sample_results/cell_projection_s006/results.json').read_text())['rows'][0]['observations'][1]['point_reference_B_T']  #: Bind source preservation and the off-axis comparison to independently generated free-space reference data.
+        for order in [0,3]:  #: Exercise unchanged original and genuine higher native curl spaces.
+            r=solve_native(p,dict(maxh_m=.2,max_passes=1,hcurl_order=order,probes_m=[[.53,.52,.54]]),True);rows.append(r)  #: Run real conforming native geometry, assembly, source solve and unit matrix.
+            self.assertEqual(r['stats']['native_hcurl_order'],order);self.assertLess(r['stats']['energy_consistency'],1e-5);self.assertLess(r['stats']['reciprocity'],1e-7)  #: Preserve actual selected-space metadata and existing physical/algebraic guards.
+            self.assertAlmostEqual(r['inductance_H'][0][0]/(2*r['stats']['energy_J']),1,places=6)  #: Require energy and the actually solved unit-current inductance to agree.
+        error=lambda r:sum((x-y)**2 for x,y in zip(r['probes'][0]['B_T'],truth))**.5  #: Compare full vectors without discarding transverse components.
+        self.assertLess(error(rows[1]),error(rows[0]));self.assertGreater(rows[1]['stats']['dofs'],rows[0]['stats']['dofs']);self.assertEqual(p,before)  #: Demonstrate real additional approximation capacity and preserved physical source for this fixture only.
+        self.assertIn('centroid',' '.join(rows[1]['warnings']))  #: Keep the original display/export sampling limitation visible with higher-order output.
+
+if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()  #: Support reproducible focused qualification in both reference and native environments.

@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+"""S007: frozen Netgen OCCT metadata resolves exact bundled DLLs; no executable built."""
+import importlib.metadata as metadata  #: Exercise the same standard-library file lookup used by the upstream loader.
+from pathlib import Path  #: Build explicit temporary installed and frozen directory layouts.
+import tempfile  #: Keep synthetic packaging fixtures outside runtime source and historical evidence.
+import unittest  #: Require real relocation and fail-closed incomplete-inventory behavior.
+from tools.build_desktop import stage_netgen_occt  #: Test the actual production build function without generating an application executable.
+
+
+class NativePackagingTests(unittest.TestCase):  #: Verify packaging semantics independently of unavailable Windows execution.
+    def test_relocated_record_resolves_exact_dll_bytes(self):  #: Model installed-prefix DLL records that cannot be reused inside a frozen root.
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:  #: Isolate exact synthetic wheel and bundle fixture bytes.
+            root=Path(temporary);site=root/'installed/site';info=site/'netgen_occt-7.8.1.dist-info';info.mkdir(parents=True);(root/'installed/bin').mkdir();bundle=root/'bundle'  #: Separate installation prefix, original metadata and actual frozen resources.
+            (info/'METADATA').write_text('Name: netgen-occt\nVersion: 7.8.1\n');(info/'RECORD').write_text('../bin/TKernel.dll,,\n../bin/TKMath.dll,,\nnetgen_occt-7.8.1.dist-info/METADATA,,\n')  #: Retain genuine relative-prefix metadata lookup semantics in the fixture.
+            for name in ['TKernel.dll','TKMath.dll']:(root/'installed/bin'/name).write_bytes(name.encode())  #: Make source identity checks independent of filenames alone.
+            flags=stage_netgen_occt(metadata.PathDistribution(info),root/'staged');bundle.mkdir();staged=Path(flags[1].split(';')[0]);import shutil;shutil.copytree(staged,bundle/staged.name);(bundle/'netgen_occt_libs').mkdir()  #: Run actual production staging and materialize its declared frozen destinations without freezing code.
+            for i in range(2,len(flags),2):source,destination=flags[i+1].split(';');shutil.copyfile(source,bundle/destination/Path(source).name)  #: Interpret exact production binary flags rather than recreating its lookup record in the test.
+            frozen=metadata.PathDistribution(bundle/info.name);files=frozen.files;self.assertEqual({f.name for f in files},{'TKernel.dll','TKMath.dll'})  #: Require upstream file enumeration to discover every packaged OCCT library.
+            for member in files:self.assertTrue(member.locate().resolve().is_relative_to(bundle));self.assertEqual(member.locate().read_bytes(),member.name.encode())  #: Require actual bundle-local file resolution and exact original DLL bytes.
+            self.assertEqual(frozen.version,'7.8.1')  #: Preserve upstream version identity through relocation.
+
+    def test_missing_dll_rejected(self):  #: Do not generate a package whose metadata advertises absent native binaries.
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:  #: Keep the malformed synthetic distribution isolated.
+            root=Path(temporary);info=root/'netgen_occt-7.8.1.dist-info';info.mkdir();(info/'METADATA').write_text('Name: netgen-occt\nVersion: 7.8.1\n');(info/'RECORD').write_text('TKernel.dll,,\n')  #: Declare an actually missing required upstream kernel.
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'incomplete'):stage_netgen_occt(metadata.PathDistribution(info),root/'stage')  #: Require a build failure before PyInstaller or runtime native execution.
+
+
+if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()  #: Expose reproducible standalone packaging checks.

+"""Whole-result ordinary-native equivalence against an explicitly supplied prior checkout."""

+SCRIPT="""import json,sys  #: Use this isolated child interpreter and canonical finite JSON.

+from engine.ngsolve_backend import solve_native  #: Execute actual original/default native FEM code, not cached fields.
+from pathlib import Path  #: Locate the same original physical fixture in the selected checkout.
+mode=sys.argv[2];root=Path(sys.argv[1])  #: Keep dimensional fixture and source identity explicit.
+p=json.loads((root/('examples/transformer_2d.json' if mode=='2d' else 'sample_results/local_field_s005/results.json')).read_text())  #: Load original source data without conversion.
+if mode=='3d':p=p['rows'][0]['project']  #: Reuse the identical verified spatial ideal-sheet project.
+r=solve_native(p,dict(maxh_m=.015 if mode=='2d' else .2,max_passes=1),True)  #: Actually mesh and solve the unchanged default-order field and full unit-excitation matrix.
+r['stats'].pop('seconds');r['stats'].pop('native_hcurl_order',None)  #: Exclude only nondeterministic elapsed time and the newly added descriptive order metadata.
+print(json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False))  #: Emit every remaining deterministic physical source, field, mesh, matrix and diagnostic for complete-byte comparison.
+"""  #: Keep both module trees isolated so shared imports cannot make an invalid equivalence claim.
+records={}  #: Retain separate actual planar and spatial comparison identities.
+for mode in ['2d','3d']:  #: Preserve both existing native formulations and ordinary defaults.
+    data=[subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-c',SCRIPT,str(source),mode],check=True,capture_output=True).stdout for source in [Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(),ROOT]]  #: Execute both independent checkouts using the same qualified native interpreter.

+D=ROOT/'sample_results/native_order_s007';D.mkdir(exist_ok=True);(D/'default_equivalence.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(records))  #: Preserve reproducible actual default-equivalence evidence without rewriting the old source.
